observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "===== UI page GET / ====="
curl -s -o /tmp/root.html -w 'GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}, bytes=%{size_download}\n' http://localhost:3000/
grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/root.html | head -1
echo "===== mock auth flow ====="
rm -f /tmp/cj3.txt
curl -s -c /tmp/cj3.txt -o /dev/null -w 'POST /auth/dev-login -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' -X POST http://localhost:3000/auth/dev-login
echo "--- /auth/me (with session) ---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -w '\n-> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/auth/me
echo "--- /api/v1/iam/me/context (with session) ---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -w '\n-> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/iam/me/context | head -c 500; echo
